title: Sputnik 1
text: The first artificial satellite. Its radio beeps were heard around the world for three weeks.

title: Sputnik 2
text: Carried Laika, the first animal to orbit Earth.

title: Explorer 1
text: The first US satellite; its instruments discovered the Van Allen radiation belts.

title: Vanguard 1
text: The oldest human-made object still in orbit.

title: Vostok 1
text: Yuri Gagarin becomes the first human in space and in orbit.

title: Telstar 1
text: The first active communications satellite to relay television across the Atlantic.

title: Syncom 2
text: The first satellite in a geosynchronous orbit.

title: Intelsat I "Early Bird"
text: The first commercial communications satellite in geosynchronous orbit.

title: Salyut 1
text: The first space station.

title: Skylab
text: The first US space station, home to three crews in 1973–74.

title: First GPS satellite
text: Navstar 1 begins the Global Positioning System.

title: Skylab re-enters
text: Skylab falls back to Earth, scattering debris over Western Australia.

title: Mir
text: The core module of Mir, the first modular space station, reaches orbit.

title: Hubble Space Telescope
text: Launched aboard the Space Shuttle Discovery and deployed the next day.

title: ISS: Zarya
text: The first module of the International Space Station is launched.

title: Mir de-orbited
text: After 15 years in orbit, Mir is guided into the South Pacific.

title: Fengyun-1C anti-satellite test
text: China destroys its own weather satellite with a missile, creating the largest debris cloud on record.

title: Iridium 33 – Cosmos 2251 collision
text: The first accidental hypervelocity collision between two intact satellites, about 790 km above Siberia.

title: First OneWeb satellites
text: The first six satellites of the OneWeb broadband constellation.

title: First Starlink batch
text: 60 satellites begin SpaceX's mega-constellation — now the majority of active satellites.

title: Tiangong: Tianhe
text: The core module of China's space station.

title: Cosmos 1408 anti-satellite test
text: Russia destroys a defunct satellite, forcing the ISS crew to shelter.
